label: synthetic RO, ERA5-driven
residual_source: M6 WindNBM GRU (sentinel.model.wind.nbm) trained in-process on the thermal objective, label-free mask (finite, no error code; no labels, no drift mask); held-out park uses embedding 0
normal_selection: label-free (no labels, no drift mask) for fitting residuals; features computed on all steps

splits.rule: pre-test time of the training parks in contiguous blocks; thresholds tuned on out-of-fold predictions and frozen; final LightGBM refit on all pre-test rows; held-out park and test year never in training

definitions.alarm: p_fail_14d >= threshold (model) / daily mean residual minus own 21-60 d lagged baseline >= threshold degC (baseline), per turbine-component-day
definitions.true_alarm: failure of that component within 14 d after the alarm day ends
definitions.lead_time_h: median over detected events of failure onset - end of first true alarm day
definitions.false_alarms: episodes of false alarm days per turbine (gaps <= 2 d merged) / turbine-year

ship.rule: ship iff (1) median lead time > 0 on held-out test events (test year, all parks) and (2) on the held-out park, and (3) M7's event recall at its frozen validation threshold beats the fixed-threshold baseline at <= the same false-alarm rate (baseline given its best test threshold with FA <= M7's test FA)

notes: Simulator fails only gearbox_t / gen1_t / gen2_t; converter / transformer rows are all negative.
40 % of degradation drifts do not end in a failure: alarms on them count as false alarms here.
No M6 overheating-class baseline: M6's classifier is not trained in this run.

Protocol history (disclosed): first drafts counted false alarms per alarm DAY run outside the 14-d window and used one validation split; that scored an early alarm on the same drift as a false alarm and tuned on 7 events. Final protocol (applied identically to M7 and the baseline): episode-level false alarms, 4-fold time-blocked CV for thresholds, baseline-oracle equal-FA check.
